instruction: Give a 5-star rating to all songs in my Spotify playlists which I have liked. If I have already rated it lower, increase it to 5.

steps.code:
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='as_moore@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print(login_result)

access_token = login_result["access_token"]
playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    playlists.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(playlists))
for p in playlists:
    print(p["playlist_id"], p["title"], len(p.get("song_ids", [])))

steps.code:
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
liked_song_ids = set(s["song_id"] for s in liked_songs)
print(len(liked_songs), sorted(liked_song_ids))

playlist_song_ids = set()
for p in playlists:
    for sid in p.get("song_ids", []):
        playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
print("All playlist songs:", sorted(playlist_song_ids))
target_songs = playlist_song_ids & liked_song_ids
print("Liked songs in playlists:", sorted(target_songs))
